info.title: quiver/arrow-2
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "quiver/arrow-2", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description:
The Quiver AI text-to-SVG fields, shared by the v1 `POST /proxy/quiver/v1/svgs/generations` request body and the Comfy Router input schema for `quiver/arrow-2` and `quiver/arrow-2-telos`. See the note above `RecraftImageGenerationInputs` for why the two surfaces share properties but not `required`.
`required` here is the ROUTER-SAFE floor: `model` is absent from it because Router writes the path's model into the body after routervalidate.Guard has already validated the caller's bytes. The v1 wrapper `QuiverTextToSVGRequest` re-adds it.

example.prompt: A single red maple leaf on a plain white background.

presence_penalty.description: Penalty for tokens already present in prior output. Ignored by `arrow-2-telos`, which does not accept sampling parameters; the field is removed from the request before it is forwarded, without an error.

prompt.description: Text description of the desired SVG output

references.description: Optional reference images to guide style/composition. Accepts URL object, base64 object, or URL string shorthand. Runtime limits are model-specific.

oneOf.description: URL string shorthand for a reference image

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Ignored by `arrow-2-telos`, which does not accept sampling parameters; the field is removed from the request before it is forwarded, without an error.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling probability. Ignored by `arrow-2-telos`, which does not accept sampling parameters; the field is removed from the request before it is forwarded, without an error.

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description:
Comfy Router output schema for the Quiver Arrow text-to-SVG models: Quiver's own generation response, forwarded unchanged. The operation is direct-return (`routerresult/classification.go` classifies the Quiver generations route as ReturnModeDirect, and quiver.go registers no task checker), so the body a caller receives is this finished document from the one call — there is no task handle and no poll.
The generated SVGs are in `data[]`, each with the raw markup at `data[].svg`. `arrow-2` and `arrow-2-telos` are both token-priced: a success reports measured totals in `usage`, and `credits` -- the flat-credit shape fixed-credit Quiver models such as the retired `arrow-1.1` report -- is omitted.

QuiverImageObject.description: Image input for Quiver AI (URL or base64)

url.description: Network image URL. Only http/https URLs allowed.

QuiverSVGResponse.description: Response from Quiver AI SVG generation/vectorization

credits.description: Credit cost for fixed-credit models such as arrow-1.1. Omitted for token-priced models such as arrow-2, which report measured token totals in usage.

usage.description: Token totals for token-priced models such as arrow-2. Fixed-credit models may report zeros here.

input_tokens.description: Input token count for token-priced models.

output_tokens.description: Output token count for token-priced models.

total_tokens.description: Total token count for token-priced models.
